annotations.title: Import a memory pack as proposals

description: Bring a memory pack into a project. Everything in it lands as a PROPOSAL for the human to sanction in review — never as an active rule, no matter what the pack says about itself. A pack has the authority to ASK, never to decide: what arrives is a stranger's opinion until someone here says otherwise. Nothing is pinned on import either, because pinning spends this project's reading budget in every session from now on, and that is the owner's call with their own shelf in view. If any part of the document is malformed, NOTHING is imported and the refusal says how many units were left out — half an import is worse than none, because the memory that did not make it is the one nobody will go looking for.

pack.description: The pack document itself, as it was written by arroway_export. Read the file and pass its contents — this server does not fetch URLs on your behalf.

project.description: Project slug. If it did not come from the person or from a read in this session, it is a guess: check it against the roster that opens arroway_catch_up before writing, because material from one circle must never land in another.
